messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
All jumbled up inside my head just screaming `` set me free! ''

output.original_text: All jumbled up inside my head just screaming `` set me free! ''
output.joy: I feel so full of excitement inside, just joyfully shouting, `` set me free! ''
output.sadness: I’m so confused and lost inside my head, quietly crying, `` set me free! ''
output.fear: I’m all tangled up inside my head, terrified and begging, `` set me free! ''
output.anger: I’m so furious, all jumbled up inside my head, yelling, `` set me free! ''
output.surprise: I can't believe how mixed up I feel inside my head, suddenly shouting, `` set me free! ''
output.disgust: I feel so revolted and jumbled inside my head, screaming, `` set me free! ''
